subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Sudha Murthy dealt with complex psychological issues in her stories in a __lucid__ manner.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Comprehensible**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the underlined and the given word:
 
 
• **"Lucid" means something clear and easy to understand.** (स्पष्ट अर्थ का)

 
 
• ​Example: She has a lucid style of explaining.
 
 
 
• **"Comprehensible" means easily understood or clear.**(समझने के योग्य)
 
 
• Example: The explanation of the science at work was clear, concise and comprehensible.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "comprehensible" is a synonym of lucid, which is the word underlined in the sentence.
 
• Sudha Murthy's stories dealt with complex psychological issues in a way that was easily understood.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Poignant means emotionally moving or touching.(मार्मिक)
 
• Implicit means implied or suggested without being directly stated.(निर्विवाद)
 
• Exquisite means extremely beautiful or delicate. (उत्कृष्ट)
